video_title: Channing Frye Reveals the Moment He Knew LeBron’s Brain Was DIFFERENT

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on LeBron James's elite basketball IQ and anticipation
quotes.excerpt: This is when I realized his brain is like a freaking computer.
quotes.quote: This is when I realized his brain is like a freaking computer. Him and T-Lue put me in every spot and literally showed me how he was going to throw me the ball if somebody did this. That was like, okay, you different, brother.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: New NBA owners are hesitant to pay for championship-level teams
quotes.excerpt: They're not willing to just pay hundreds of millions of dollars for a team that might win it.
quotes.quote: New owners are willing to shell out a lot of money, but they're not willing to just pay hundreds of millions of dollars for a team that might win it.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers will likely need to rebuild within two years
quotes.excerpt: If you really think about what Philly is now, they're going to have to blow that team up.
quotes.quote: If you really think about what Philly is now, they're going to have to blow that team up somehow in the next two years.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's trade was a strategic move by Celtics ownership
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown got traded because the way our CBA is set up, you can't be in the second apron.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown got traded because the way our CBA is set up, you can't be in the second apron year after year after year, especially with not new owners. New owners are willing to shell out a lot of money, but they're not willing to just pay hundreds of millions of dollars for a team that might win it.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves are a top-four team in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: The Timberwolves are going to be a top four team in the Western Conference for sure.
quotes.quote: The Timberwolves are going to be a top four team in the Western Conference for sure. I don't know if the Rockets have made any changes other than get an injured guy back. They haven't addressed anything. They're the same team and you got to change something up. You got to bring in some energy there.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James and Tyronn Lue integrating Channing Frye into offense
quotes.excerpt: I realized his brain is like a freaking computer because he put me in every spot.
quotes.quote: When I first got traded, Richard Jefferson and Tyronn Lue asked me to wait after practice. They said they were going to put this play in just for me. LeBron James asked if I remembered horns up Memphis twist. I asked how he knew that, and he said he watched film on my best years in Phoenix and that play was really nasty. He broke it down, asking if there was a side I liked. He noted Tristan Thompson likes to jump from one side and asked if I could shoot from the other. He asked if we could put me in the corner because he wanted to see the big man make a decision. He noted Steve Nash was smaller, so he had to go one way because he couldn't throw over the top where he could. This is when I realized his brain is like a freaking computer because he and Tyronn Lue put me in every spot and literally showed me how he was going to throw me the ball if somebody did this.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Regular season MVP is more impactful than Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: I think a regular season MVP is more impactful to a player's legacy than a Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: I think a regular season MVP is more impactful to a player's legacy than a Finals MVP because I believe it's easier for someone to be the best player in a game of seven series versus being the best in the NBA over an 82 game season. When you're in NBA Finals, that's the men in black, the best of the best of the best of the best, sir. And those you are playing somebody who has studied you for weeks, maybe almost months. There is nothing they don't know about your basketball game. Any flaw, any crack in the armor, anything, they're going to get exposed. So to be a Finals MVP means that you are the best player on the best stage and that weight, even though it is a best of seven, is very different. The pressure, the weight, the everything about it is very different. When you are the best player over an 82 game season, you are still great. You are still great. You are amazing. It is about your consistent preparation to be the best player night in and night out. There have been great MVPs that are okay during the playoffs. There's really never been a Finals MVP that hasn't been good during the NBA NBA season, other than Kawhi Leonard where he was hurt.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Player bonuses tied to 65-game rule are fair
quotes.excerpt: If they're going to give it to you, you take it.
quotes.quote: If they're going to give it to you, you take it. But also, teams can sit you down. So you got to have good relationship with your organization because they may say, hey, you're going to sit this game out and you say, okay. And then you twist an ankle and now you're at 63. So now you don't get a bonus. Maybe they don't bring you back. So that happens too. So yes, it's it's fair because it's fair and love and war on both sides.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James would not have left Cleveland if they won in 2016
quotes.excerpt: If Kyrie misses that game winner in game 7, LeBron leaves, KD never joins the warriors.
quotes.quote: Should have, could have, would have, and LeBron wouldn't have left. I think KD would have never came and we would have beat the Warriors next year. That's really what what happened and we might have won the next four four championships.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive Player of the Year should not be split by position
quotes.excerpt: No, defensive player is defensive player.
quotes.quote: No, defensive player is defensive player. And just because Wembanyama exists, there's been a bunch of tall guys that have played in the NBA and to get a unanimous defensive player of the year just shows you guys just don't have a chance. I mean, he just that good. A third team I can agree with. I think there are enough players who hang their hat every day on defending need to be acknowledged. I think a lot of people get caught up in the blocks and steals, but there are guys that are just lockdown defenders statistically that make you shoot the worst shot in your repertoire every single night.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Atlanta Hawks are no longer a mid-tier team
quotes.excerpt: The Hawks were mid. I think the Hawks are done being mid.
quotes.quote: The Hawks were mid. I think the Hawks are done being mid. Adding Lou Dort, I think they added Wiggins was the right one. They're building a great base and I think Jaylen Johnson is a great player. They just need a star. They can go get a star, right? They can say, hey, let's go for it. Let's go get a star or they're going to develop a homegrown star. But I think no, the Hawks are not mid anymore, 2026, but they were mid for about six years, seven years, 10 years, 10 years probably.
